We’re glad to be here tonight in the service of the Lord. So happy to be down here in this lovely state of Kentucky again, my home state. No matter where you ever go, there’s something about where you were born and raised that always makes you long to get back. I haven’t had many meetings in Kentucky, especially the type of meetings of this type of praying for the sick and so forth. But I have preached quite a bit in Kentucky, a little further down at, on near Glasgow or Burkesville, rather, where I was born at. I don’t know whether any of you knows the old Methodist Church just above Renox Creek up there, just out of Glasgow, called White Hill; there’s where all my people are buried, practically all of them here, and that died here in this state.
